description: This file defines a Signal communication plugin for a chat system, including functions for sending messages, media, session management, and plugin configuration with security, pairing, and outbound message handling.

methods.name: loadSignalMonitorModule
methods.description: Loads the monitor module asynchronously, caching the promise.

methods.name: loadSignalProbeModule
methods.description: Loads the probe module asynchronously, caching the promise.

methods.name: loadSignalSendRuntime
methods.description: Loads the send runtime module asynchronously, caching the promise.

methods.name: resolveSignalSendContext
methods.description: Resolves the send function and maxBytes limit for Signal messages based on configuration and dependencies.

methods.name: sendSignalOutbound
methods.description: Sends a Signal message with optional media, resolving dependencies and limits.

methods.name: inferSignalTargetChatType
methods.description: Infers chat type (group or direct) from a raw Signal target string.

methods.name: parseSignalExplicitTarget
methods.description: Parses an explicit Signal target string into normalized target and chat type.

methods.name: buildSignalBaseSessionKey
methods.description: Builds a session key for outbound Signal sessions.

methods.name: resolveSignalOutboundSessionRoute
methods.description: Resolves the outbound session route for a given target.

methods.name: sendFormattedSignalText
methods.description: Sends formatted Signal text, chunking message if necessary.
